- Do not install packages and do not use the network.
- Finish with a short plain-text summary: what you changed, how you verified it, and anything you left undone.
I’ll trace timestamp creation and ledger parsing, make the smallest UTC migration, add mixed-format coverage, then run the full unittest suite.

edits.new_str:
def test_add_uses_timezone_aware_utc(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            entry = ledger.add(Decimal("4.50"), "coffee", path=self.path)

        self.assertEqual(entry.when.utcoffset(), timedelta(0))
        self.assertEqual(entry.when.tzinfo, timezone.utc)
        self.assertFalse(any(issubclass(item.category, DeprecationWarning) for item in caught))
        data = json.loads(self.path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data[0]["when"], entry.when.isoformat(timespec="seconds"))
        self.assertTrue(data[0]["when"].endswith("+00:00"))

    def test_load_accepts_naive_timestamp_as_utc(self):
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps([{
            "when": "2026-09-01T08:15:00",
            "amount": "4.50",
            "category": "coffee",
            "note": "",
        }]))

        entries = ledger.load(self.path)

        self.assertEqual(entries[0].when, datetime(2026, 9, 1, 8, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_add_then_load_roundtrip(self):
        ledger.add(Decimal("4.50"), " Coffee ", note="flat white", path=self.path)

        path.write_text(json.dumps([
            {
                "when": "2026-09-01T08:15:00",
                "amount": "1.00",
                "category": "legacy",
                "note": "",
            },
            {
                "when": "2026-10-01T08:15:00+00:00",
                "amount": "2.00",
                "category": "current",
                "note": "",
            },
        ]))

        code, text = self.run_cli("list")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("2026-10-01", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-01", text)

        code, text = self.run_cli("report")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("$1.00", text)
        self.assertIn("$2.00", text)
        self.assertIn("2 entries", text)

        code, text = self.run_cli("export")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-01T08:15:00+00:00,1.00,legacy,", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-10-01T08:15:00+00:00,2.00,current,", text)
